description: Election Commission - Order to appoint Mr. Asoka Priyantha Bandara Herath Mudiyanselage as a member of the Central Province Provincial Council of Nuwara-Eliya to fill the vacacncy under the Provincial Councils Elections Act, No. 2 of 1988
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the Central Province Provincial Council due to a member's death. It details the electoral process under the Provincial Councils Elections Act, including the nomination by a political party and the formal declaration by the Election Commission of a new member. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related matters, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
